name: KittyLaunch

sources.title: KittyLaunch homepage + FAQ — 100% free launch, weekly Monday cycles, deals, archive
SuperKitty — one-time per-product upgrade (skip the line, 7 dofollow backlinks, Spotlight ticket, bundled tools)

requirements: Indie makers, SaaS founders, solo builders and small product teams
Products launch in weekly cycles starting Monday (UTC); you can publish immediately or schedule a future date
preparation: Product name, tagline, category (SaaS, AI/ML, Marketing, Productivity, E-commerce, Finance, Developer Tools, etc.), logo and screenshots
Optional deal/promo code to attach (deals are shown on the homepage and Deals page)
Choice between publishing immediately or scheduling into a future week

Optional: SuperKitty one-time upgrade decision — removes 'Similar products' competitor section, skips weekly capacity limits, instant badge approval, 7 dofollow backlinks, a Spotlight homepage ticket, review if top 3, plus bundled tools (feedback portal, waitlist, reviews widget, KittyPilot marketing kit, uptime monitoring)
workflow: Go to /new/product and create the listing
Publish immediately or schedule for a future launch week
Collect community upvotes during the launch week; top 3 earn winner badges and a Weekly Archive spot
watchFor: Standard product pages include a 'Similar Products' section recommending competitor apps — SuperKitty removes it
Weekly launch capacity is limited — free launches may wait if a week is full; SuperKitty skips the line
SuperKitty price shows as early-bird and renders dynamically (price not stated in fetched text)
Dofollow backlink is tied to earning a 'verified badge' per the FAQ
Featured/Spot Sponsored launch slots are paid add-ons
countsAsLive: Product page at /p/<slug> publicly reachable and appearing in Latest Launches / its category with an upvote count
unknowns: Exact SuperKitty and Featured placement prices (page renders prices client-side)
How the verified badge/dofollow is granted on free launches (manual review vs automatic)
Whether every free launch also gets a dofollow link or only verified/top products
